pictures.name: RE1-Six-Days-Done
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich hand-woven textiles, deep blue shadows and warm gold lamplight, soft painterly brushwork, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos, no modern objects. The newly finished world at golden evening: a lush garden beside a calm sea, trees heavy with fruit, deer, birds and lions resting together, the first stars appearing in a deep blue sky above glowing clouds. No people in focus, no figure of God. Completeness, goodness.

No text, no letters, no logos, no modern objects. A Jewish family home in a simple older setting on a Friday evening at sunset: a wooden table with a white cloth, two lit candles in brass holders, a braided loaf of bread under an embroidered cloth, a cup of wine. A mother, father, grandmother and children sit together, relaxed and smiling, work tools set aside by the door. Warm, peaceful, respectful.

pictures.name: RE6-Today

No text, no letters, no logos, no modern objects. (Exception: this is a today scene, so modern objects are allowed.) A modern setting painted in the same contemplative oil style, warm light, no readable text or logos. A modern living room on a Sunday morning. A person rests in an armchair by a sunny window with a cup of tea, a phone lying face-down on the side table and a laptop closed; through the window, a small church steeple in the distance. Calm, unhurried, restful.
